description: Information an assistant keeps across sessions, written to and read from a store around model calls.
The rules for what is worth storing: importance threshold, shape rules, exclusions. Mechanical rules are testable.
Turning a conversation into short, self-contained statements with a model, validated like any structured output.
Merging a new memory into the most similar existing one when their embedding similarity is above a threshold.
How memories are chosen for a call: scoring, top-k and the token budget they may use.
An exponential score, `decay ** hoursSinceLastAccess`, so memories fade unless they keep being used.
A rating given at write time (1–10 in Generative Agents) so critical facts outrank trivia.
Park et al., 2023: agents with a memory stream retrieved by a weighted sum of relevance, recency and importance, plus reflection.
Writing memories during the reply (visible, adds latency) or after the session (no latency, visible to other sessions later).
